Knowledge sharing

Workshops

Hands-on sessions built and delivered for engineering teams and student communities, mostly on the layers below the application: hardware, assembly and algorithms.

Sessions delivered

  • Introduction to CS Fundamentals — Hardware

    2026

    Instructor · OLIVE-LEARN programme at OLIVESOFT

    • Instructor
    • Two-part series
    • Slides (.pptx)
    • Part 1 — Efficient code execution & hardware architectures: modern computing architectures, CPU instruction pipelining, memory hierarchies and caching, and DMA, NIC and APU interactions.
    • Part 2 — Circuit-level computation & storage: building foundational computing units from SR and D latches up to a 4-bit register, 1-bit and 4-bit adders, and an arithmetic logic unit.

  • Assembly Programming Workshop

    2023

    Hands-on session · Securinets Club, ENIS

    • Hands-on
    • Securinets Club

    A practical exploration of low-level programming in Assembly, with exercises participants worked through on their own machines.

  • Introduction to Competitive Programming

    2023

    Instructor · IEEE Student Branch, ENIS

    • Instructor
    • IEEE Student Branch

    Problem-solving technique, core data structures and the algorithm patterns that recur across contest problems.

  • Introduction to Python

    2022

    Instructor · IEEE Student Branch, ENIS

    • Instructor
    • IEEE Student Branch

    Python fundamentals taught through two builds: a console noughts-and-crosses game, and reading and charting CSV data.
